title: Room Directory v1
description: Snapshot of the room directory — every known room with its current stage, hardware summary, and the number of apps + skills it exposes. Published by the P7 room-orchestrator on catalog reload (or when a room transitions to a new stage). The cached projection is consumed by the dashboard, room-suggest-skill, and pmoves-helpdesk-skill to answer 'which room should I open?' questions without re-reading the on-disk catalog each time.

snapshot_id.description: Unique id for this directory snapshot. Useful for cache invalidation.

room_purpose.description: Slice-1 manifest field — the room's purpose (studio, classroom, etc.). Null when not declared.

creator_surface.description: Slice-1 manifest field — the creator surface the room targets (primary, secondary, none). Null when not a creator room.

stage.description: Current P7 stage for the room. unknown when the room is loaded but not yet staged.

active_session_id.description: P7 session id currently active in the room. Null when no active session.

hardware_summary.description: Optional compact hardware summary derived from hardware_requirements (gpu, min_vram_mb, node_roles, cpu_arch). Free-form; mirrors the manifest's hardware_requirements block.

snapshot_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the snapshot was taken.
